criteria.contact_force_definition: Ground-filtered normal force in worldZ N; at least one wheel exceeds5N each physical sample.
criteria.qualitative_review: Render whole-body and fixed-world XY; cannot declare task complete solely from lower HF or summed reward.

nominal_screen.baseline: original400Hz CEM+beta nativeMuJoCo mu=.7; controller-matched oldcontactreward
nominal_screen.note: This is the CEM-only numerical screen; completion also needs PPO/engine validation and qualitative review.

limitations: ACTUAL closed-loop B episode only; not offline A-force sensitivity or a PPO result.
N=1 per controller; no causal population effect or universal friction threshold.
Reward definitions differ across original/A/B: episode reward sums are not a fair performance ranking.
Any-wheel continuity requires actual Fz>5N; the other wheel may lift; zero force is not a geometric flight label.
Acceptance criteria are frozen unchanged; no height/tilt/beta gate replaces independent XY tracking.
Numerical CEM acceptance does not certify qualitative review, PPO/dual-engine results or overall task completion.
